verdict.statement: Class II prediction can confirm the DO11.10 / I-A(d) system control and can score the all-L constructs of 11 residues or more. It cannot score the 8-mer control, and it cannot score any D-substituted peptide. Since the comparison Step 1 is built around is all-L control versus D-substituted test, in-silico cannot perform that comparison - it can only characterise the L arm.
